name: CodeElo
intro: CodeElo收录2024年5月4日至11月4日期间54场Codeforces评级竞赛中的387道题，并附带竞赛分区、题目Rating和算法标签。模型最多生成8次尝试，代码被直接提交至Codeforces官方平台，以隐藏测试、特殊/交互评测器和统一执行环境判定，再从54场比赛的人类排名估计可比较的Elo Rating。
build_method: Codeforces近期评级竞赛收集, HTML解析, 官方平台直接评测, 人类排名Elo估计
eval_feature: Codeforces官方隐藏测试, 特殊与交互评测器, 最多8次尝试, 人类可比Elo
build_method_en: Recent rated Codeforces contests, HTML parsing, direct official-platform judging, human-rank Elo estimation
eval_feature_en: Official hidden tests, special and interactive judges, up to eight attempts, human-comparable Elo
intro_en: CodeElo contains 387 problems from 54 rated Codeforces contests held from May 4 to November 4, 2024, with contest divisions, problem ratings, and algorithm tags. Models generate up to eight attempts, which are submitted directly to Codeforces for hidden-test, special/interactive-judge, and platform-aligned execution. Human-comparable Elo ratings are then estimated from the model's ranks across the 54 contests.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2501.01257v2 §§3.1–3.3, §4.1, and Appendix B. Operational evidence is official repository snapshot 0bffc84f0477abe5fd641d4cb4c859318a572c70 (main.py, llm_client.py, calc_rating.py) and Hugging Face dataset revision 45a2cbba03bd9d20fbca040c2f7da91b2594c444 (test.json). The paper experiment excludes Div. 1 contests and evaluates 387 problems from 54 rated Codeforces contests held May 4–November 4, 2024, presenting the original HTML and hiding algorithm tags. The pinned HF artifact is materially larger: 408 records from 57 contests, including 21 Div. 1 records, and its textual fields are Markdown; filtering those 21 records recovers the paper count but not the original HTML prompt representation. The paper requests complete C++ programs with chain-of-thought. Open-source decoding uses temperature 0.7, top_p 0.8, top_k 20, repetition penalty 1.1, and 4,096 output tokens except 32,768 for QwQ-32B-Preview; proprietary APIs use defaults. The pinned runner takes the first fenced code block, defaults an unlabeled block to C++, and generates and submits up to eight parseable attempts before checking their statuses, so it does not stop early after an accepted submission. Official hidden tests, special and interactive judges, and platform time-memory limits determine acceptance. Scoring later uses the first accepted attempt: failed attempts before it add score or penalty costs while submission-time penalties are omitted; contest rank maps to expected rating by binary search, then ratings are averaged over 54 contests. Reporting includes Elo, human percentile, and Pass@1/2/4/8 while disclosing which artifact variant was used.
